faqs.answer: Swigable is a smart bottle that tracks your intake & reminds you to drink. It Builds better habits.

Swigable is a smart water bottle brand that automatically tracks hydration habits and provides personalized reminders to help users build consistent drinking routines. The product features a 450ml stainless steel bottle with a magnetic health device, AI-powered coaching via the Swiggy® coach, real-time sip tracking, and battery life of up to 2 days. Reservation on Kickstarter at 54% discount has now ended. The bottle works standalone or with an accompanying app for enhanced tracking and insights. Designed for everyday use at home, work, or on-the-go, suitable for families with app-based parental controls. Swigable Limited is registered in England (company number 16447020).
Swigable comes in 4 colours: Teal, Candy, Carbon and Forest.
